mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) signals increased investor confidence, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth reverses or lags behind historical averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as low labor costs boost corporate profits.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite UNRATE staying below 3.5% for >3 months, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust demand-supply expansion, driving positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite both proxies rising, or IC < 0.05 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for >3 months, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply-side growth, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when INDPRO growth slows or reverses, or IC < 0.1 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 5% triggers inflation concerns, reducing investor confidence and producing negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative despite CPIAUCSL > 5% for >3 months, or p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS (<2%) paired with falling UNRATE signals dual easing, driving positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite both proxies moving in favorable directions, or IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high unemployment (UNRATE > 4%) reduces economic momentum, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative despite UNRATE > 4% for >3 months, or p-value > 0.05.
